details.label: Summary
details.text: The threat for damaging wind gusts may increase into early evening as storms approach the coast

details.label: Discussion
details.text: So far this afternoon, thunderstorms in southeast NY and eastern PA have remained disorganized within a broader band of lower reflectivity, presumably due to poor lapse rate profiles. Ahead of the ongoing storms, temperatures have warmed into the mid 80s to lower 90s with latest objective analysis indicating a corridor of steeper low-level lapse rates, which may support some storm organization into early evening, given the presence of 35-40 kt of westerly deep-layer shear

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...55-70 MPH
